title: Maru Today — Design QA (Group 3)
summary: Visual QA report comparing the Maru Today stages against a reference render, listing measurements, state coverage, responsive notes, and open cosmetic mismatches.
notes: No ADR/PRD/SPEC signals: no status frontmatter, no Decision/Consequences, no user stories or acceptance criteria, no API/schema contracts. The 'Expected/Measured/Status' table is a record of a QA run against an existing implementation (post-fix measurements), not a normative contract, so SPEC was rejected in favor of DOC. P1/P2 mismatch items describe observed deltas and one already-fixed change, not new requirements.
